verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents its own pieces for automated simulation testing: integration into existing testing and validation pipelines, workflow automation, software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop evaluation, headless standalone operation, standalone scripts, Docker for repeatable setups, and ROS 2 services to load worlds and step simulations. However, nothing in the evidence documents a CI integration or a simulation-based regression-testing workflow, so a developer must assemble that pipeline themselves. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g., CI pipeline guides or GPU CI runners), a regression-test harness with pass/fail assertions or baseline comparison, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Isaac running in CI.
